purpose: Re-execute the existing frozen WP08-D frictional structural cases on the contact active-set remediation source. This is a source requalification only; the parent physics contract, loads, material, mesh hierarchy, numerical thresholds, solver tolerances, backend, and fallback policy are not changed.

governing.execution_sha_binding: Exact frozen HEAD is supplied by the separate Owner authorization record after this contract and runner are committed.

owner_authorization.basis: Owner's explicit instruction to rerun WP07 and WP08 M1/M2/M3 after the contact mechanics remediation.
allowed: WP08-D independent reference for each successful primary mesh
WP08-D deterministic replay for each mesh whose primary and reference gates pass
not_authorized: threshold, solver parameter, mesh, load, material, contact search, or fallback changes

campaign.execution_order: Sequential, one production solve at a time; finish all primary levels before references, then replay only eligible levels.
campaign.primary: Fresh production solve at each frozen mesh level.
campaign.independent_reference: Use the frozen NumPy/KKT reference implementation; it must not import production contact/friction routines.
campaign.replay: Fresh production process at M1 only, as required by the parent contract; compare the frozen observables using the parent replay gate.
campaign.failure_policy: Preserve every raw failure. A failed mesh blocks only its dependent reference/replay; it does not alter inputs or thresholds. Continue independent primary mesh levels sequentially.

qualification_claim: Requalification evidence only; official WP08 points remain subject to Owner review.
